title: Getting Started with Document360
content: Welcome to Mini Document360! This knowledge base platform allows teams to create, organize, and share internal or customer-facing documentation with ease.

title: Best Practices for Technical Writing
content: Keep your documentation concise, use clear headings, provide code samples when necessary, and ensure articles are categorized logically for easy discovery.

title: API Documentation Overview
content: Document RESTful endpoints clearly with HTTP methods, request parameters, sample request bodies, and expected status codes with response payloads.
